name: Gerhart Bergop
original_name: ゲルハルト＝バーゴップ
source:
Star Sign: Virgo
Elemental Attribute: Earth
Special Attribute: Evil 4
Starting Spells: Fire 4/Lighting 5/Quake 6/Ice 4/Holy 2/Healing 6/Call 2/Shield 3
Symbol: An old-fashioned oak wand(Level 3)

A lecturer at the Academy.
He leaves a cold impression and it seems he doesn't care about his students outside of lectures.
He actually doesn't have any problems with his eyesight, but he's always wearing glasses.
It seems to because of something called the "Evil Eye" but...
